windows.title: Windows and doors
windows.content:
## Required information

### Measurements
- Number of windows and/or doors
- Dimensions per frame (height x width)

### Current situation
- Frame material (wood, uPVC, aluminum)
- Glass type (single, double, HR++)

### Preferences and planning
- Preferred glass type (HR++, triple)
- Desired installation date

### Budget indication
- Budget range

insulation.title: Insulation
insulation.content:
## Required information

### Insulation type
- Roof, floor, cavity wall, or facade
- Available surface area (m2)

### Current situation
- Year of construction
- Access to roof/floor/cavity

### Preferences and planning
- Preferred material (glass wool, PIR, EPS)
- Desired installation date

### Budget indication
- Budget range

electrical.title: Electrical
electrical.content:
## Required information

### Work scope
- Type of work (panel, lighting, outlets)
- Number of points or circuits

### Current situation
- Existing panel (number of circuits)
- Accessibility of wiring

### Preferences and planning
- Desired installation date

### Budget indication
- Budget range
